BUILDPLAN.md T-19 (M3).

`bank-audit`: inherit `slot_for_day` and the both-tails audit after audit; **retire** `build_deck.py`'s ledger write; the five enumerated tells at 1.5× chance; `unsafe` parity; five options with one *does not compile*; no published distribution; fit against the configured room

Criteria: AC-23–27, AC-100, G-1, G-11
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-14, T-02 (type model)
BUILDPLAN notes: Audit ticket for `build_deck.py` — G-1 has regressed four times. **Port `slot_for_day` only.** `slot_for_meetup`, the wrapper one function below it that writes the ledger, is **not** ported under any name; the ledger's only writer is T-11's release transition. Serialized on `justfile` (`bank-audit`). Adds the **option-length** rule: every option one line of at most 29 characters (`SPEC.md` §5.2, D-15).

Orchestrator notes: Criteria include AC-23a and AC-23b (through G-1). Port `slot_for_day` (build_deck.py:162) and `audit_generator` (:183) only. `slot_for_meetup` (:220) is never ported under any name. This is the only ticket allowed to touch the slot path (AC-23a). Read PHILOSOPHY.md §2 first: G-1 has regressed four times, once while fixing the previous regression. Nothing in this ticket may shape a real night's output.

Workflow mode: sub-agent-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: READY PQ-24 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/bank-audit HEAD b4d946c9baf07c0e833c0b084ffec8a63a8ad7cd BASE b4d946c9baf07c0e833c0b084ffec8a63a8ad7cd MODE active

CONTRACT-NOTE PQ-24 (plan phase; full text in the plan file). C1 G-1 hazard: EVALUATION.md:35 (canary row) says pre-reveal options go out '{letter, text} in bank order'. Every migrated record (q3 q4 q7 q8) has its correct option at bank index 4 (migrate_mvp.py writes it last) and does-not-compile at index 3. A room that renders file order shows the answer at E every night; a room that inserts the answer at slot_for_day(date) but keeps the other four in bank order leaks the slot through does-not-compile's letter (DNC at D => answer is E). Whoever builds the arrangement (T-05/T-08/T-11) must draw distractor order from the date too; T-15b/T-16 should stop writing the answer last. bank-audit measures bank order as visible: WARN today (4/4 at index 4, p=0.0016 > 0.001), FAIL at the fifth answer-last record. C2 bank.correct_index derives no ub/panic answer (returns None). C3 SPEC 3.1 has no run id, so AC-88 'fails the run' needs run membership from T-16. C4 SPEC G-11 'organizer docs carry the tells' vs EVALUATION AC-25 linting organizer docs: read as tells live only in bank/audit/. C5 build_deck.py:180 labels 0.297 p=0.999; it is the 1% lower quantile (label fixed in the port, mvp untouched). C6 pipeline/README.md:40 still calls audit a stub (not cleared for me). C7 T-02 typemodel.js not on this branch: in-tree constant parity test skips until PR #9 merges; validated against origin/ai-c11-cc/shared-web-layer instead.

ORCHESTRATOR: PRs #9 (shared web layer) and #10 (bank format) merged to main: 36250b3 then 238146e. main now carries web/shared/** and the bank format. Their branches were auto-deleted. Rebase onto origin/main (git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main), base your PR on main, and read web/shared/typemodel.js from main rather than the old branch.

DONE PQ-24 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/13 HEAD 45cd8d06221974d9c5c0d0a8c4fb35d399578b14 BASE main@238146e8d232107effe719ce634e2eaff1db511b (was origin/ai-c11-cc/bank-format@b4d946c9baf07c0e833c0b084ffec8a63a8ad7cd, merged as #10 and deleted mid-open) test-warm 4.27s on branch, 2.04s on the trial merge with main. CI on the PR: just test SUCCESS, just test-full SUCCESS; mergeable. deviations: (1) slot path in its own module popquiz/slot.py (hashlib+datetime only), re-exported from popquiz.audit, to break the slot_for_day/slot_for_meetup adjacency. (2) AC-26 noise guard: a tell fails above 1.5x chance only when the exact Poisson-binomial tail <= 0.01/m, else WARN; the bare margin failed on luck 20-30% of the time at n=4-20 (measured). (3) per-question fit/option flags fail the run only for reserve questions (AC-100 'flagged before it can be scheduled' over SPEC 5.2 'failure'); --strict gives the literal reading. (4) ledger write retired by not inheriting; mvp/build_deck.py still writes it when run by hand (mvp/ untouched). (5) slot_for_day takes a datetime.date and only n_options=5; identical to the MVP on the ISO string (730 dates). (6) sixth tell line: answer-category base rate. (7) accepted = {accepted, edited} for AC-27, AC-88 and the reserve. (8) PR targets main, not the stacked base: #10 merged and its branch was deleted between push and gh pr create; its head is in main's history, so no rebase or force-push was needed; the boot prompt's 'Based on #8' was stale (#8 is the scaffold), the body names #10. notes: bank-audit on today's bank exits 0; option position WARN because every migrated record writes the answer last (CONTRACT-NOTE C1 posted earlier; a fifth answer-last record will FAIL); q4 q7 q8 flagged option_length, none in the reserve. On the combined tree with main the typemodel.js parity test runs and passes and copy.js lints clean. Justfile: only the bank-audit recipe and PENDING entry touched (PQ-19 union). pipeline/README.md:40 still calls audit a stub (not cleared, C6). Reviewer NITs recorded in the Code review note; no Critical/Major.

PR #13 merged to main at d88fab4 with a merge commit on the client's word, after both CI jobs passed on the exact head 45cd8d0. DONE verified against gh pr view and git ls-remote. Eight deviations recorded in the DONE comment; the slot path lives in popquiz/slot.py with hashlib+datetime only; the ledger write is retired by not inheriting it. Contract note C1 (every migrated record writes the answer last) stands for the validator.
